description:
Complete redesign of the benchmark result JSON output schema from v1.1 to v2.0.

The current v1.1 schema has significant issues:
- Extensive duplication (platform in 4 locations, timing in 2+ locations)
- Poor organization (execution.metadata contains platform details)
- Verbose structures with null-filled fields
- Confusing metrics placement

This redesign creates a clean, non-duplicating schema with:
- 70-85% smaller JSON output files
- Single source of truth for all data
- Compact query format (1 line vs 7 lines per query)
- Companion files for query plans and tuning details
- Support for multi-iteration, multi-stream, and query subset runs

**Breaking change**: No backward compatibility with v1.x results.

Reference: /Users/joe/.claude/plans/radiant-stargazing-ember.md
